notes.title: Announcement of the game Red Passport: Ticket to Russia!
notes.notes: [p]Ready for an unforgettable adventure?[/p][p]I present to you [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3833430/Red_Passport_Ticket_to_Russia/"]Red Passport: Ticket to Russia[/url] — a new game in development that will transport you on a thrilling journey across the boundless expanses of Russia![/p][p]Begin your journey in a cozy apartment, where the first puzzles and decisions await you. Then head to the airport to board a plane and fly off to another city. But that's just the beginning! An epic train ride awaits you through picturesque landscapes, leading straight to Vladivostok![/p]

notes.title: Red October: gameplay video from the train carriage
notes.notes:
Comrades! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2905620/Red_October/]Red October[/url] is gaining momentum! Just released a new gameplay video showing off an exciting train scene. Get ready for a peek behind the scenes of development and see how we breathed life into the train car, filled with interactive elements and realistic physics.

In this video, you'll see the player explore the train car, interact with objects, and navigate the aisle. I put a lot of thought into the details to create a truly immersive gaming experience. Here's what to look out for:

[olist.]
[*] Realistic Animation: Watch the smooth movements of your character as he walks through the train car, explores the compartment, and interacts with objects.
[*] Dynamic physics: Objects in the train car react to the player's actions, obeying the laws of physics. Pick up a newspaper, move a suitcase, or open a window - every interaction looks natural and convincing.
[*] Interactive World: Feel a part of the game world as you open doors to neighboring compartments and admire the passing scenery outside your window. I created the most interactive environment possible to make you feel like a real participant in the events.
[/olist]

Update 2.1 has been released, here is a list of all changes:

[olist]

notes.title: Update 2.0 is out!
notes.notes:
Friends, all these days we have been working on update 2.0, which has just been released!

Here's what was added:

[olist]
[*] New town and Kamyshlov station
[*] If you drink someone else's beer in a compartment car, the passenger will beat you up and you will end up in the hospital.
[*] New location - Hospital
[*] A new type of transport is a taxi, in which you will need to catch up with the train after getting to the hospital.
[*] New achievements: “Before Kamyshlov” and “Recovered”.
[*] New weather (thunderstorm with rain)
[*] New dialogues (Hospital)
[*] Various bug fixes
[/olist]
Work on adding content is ongoing. Write reviews!

notes.title: A new update under the index 2.0 is being developed: details
notes.notes:
Dear players, I am glad that you write reviews with wishes for future updates!

Now I would like to talk about a new major update that is being developed.
At the moment, it has been noticed that at the station in Moscow there are very few activities for players, since I focused on the atmosphere of the station area so that the player would feel and feel nostalgic, but this was not enough for most players.

Modeling is currently underway for a new train station that will allow you to walk inside. The station area will also change greatly, new objects, activities, dialogues, and achievements will be added. It is planned to create the same stations for other cities (Kazan, Yekaterinburg, Novosibirsk and Vladivostok). More cities may be added in the future.

Please have a little patience, with your help the game will become, although not ideal, quite good.

notes.title: Major update
notes.notes:
Friends, a new, major update has been released right now. Here's what was added/changed:
[list]
[*] Added the city of Kazan
[*] Added achievement "Reached Kazan"
[*] The terrain through which the train travels has changed. Before Kazan there is much more forest, and after that there is more mountainous terrain.
[*] The schedule of train stops and departures has changed.
[*] Fixed a bug when dark artifacts were visible on some buildings in cities
[*] Walking speed increased by 5%
[*] Running speed increased by an additional 10%
[*] Increased the number of buildings near the station
[*] Now the player in his compartment can lie on the upper shelves
[*] The conductor at the carriage has been replaced (now the conductors at the station and in the player’s carriage are the same)
[/list]
Please write about any errors or bugs you find in the discussions. It will be fixed quickly. Thank you!

notes.title: Game update: bug fixes
notes.notes:
Friends, thank you very much for your comments and reviews, where you write about the errors/bugs found and other shortcomings.

Over the course of 2 days, many small urgent updates were released, where critical errors were corrected.
Now an update has been released that fixes some bugs, namely:

[olist]
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could suddenly move vertically and the character would appear to be flying.
[*] Increased running speed by 15%.
[*] The dancing character was removed from the reserved seat car (as it turned out, he interfered with many people’s ability to move around the car)
[*] The key to the door of the reserved seat carriage was slightly moved to a more visible place (judging by your streams and video reviews, only 40% of all players were able to find the lost key)
[*] Fixed minor errors in text translations
[/olist]

notes.title: Urgent update
notes.notes:
A bug was discovered in the game with a bus that stood still and did not move when the player was inside.

[b]Fixed. Please update the game.[/b]

notes.title: Игра выпущена в релиз!
notes.notes:
Dear players, the game has been released!

Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the endless expanses and beauty of Russia in the new game Trans-Siberian Legends, already available on Steam! This is not just a game, it is a journey in which everyone can become a passenger on the legendary Trans-Siberian Express.

🛤️ Explore unique cities and regions, meet interesting characters and collect unforgettable experiences. Your train is already on the platform, get ready to leave!

🎮Game Features:
[list]
[*] Realistic recreation of the Trans-Siberian Railway
[*] Interaction with various characters
[*] Exciting stories and quests
[*] Complete immersion in the atmosphere of travel
[/list]

notes.title: The game comes out on March 18th!
notes.notes:
So, dear friends, the game will be released on March 18th!

You are embarking on an epic train journey along the vast Trans-Siberian Railway. Your mission: reach your final destination through a thrilling storyline that unfolds over multiple stages.

During your trip, you will explore picturesque cities, enjoy panoramic views from your window, and watch the landscapes, climates and architectural styles change. Tune in to the radio and strike up conversations with fellow travelers to delve deeper into Russia's cultural richness.

Discover pristine forests, endless fields, majestic mountains, vibrant cities and charming villages. This game will take you on an exciting railway adventure filled with exciting events, new discoveries and unforgettable emotions.

A photo camera and album have been added to the game. Now you can capture everything you want on camera while traveling. Each player will have their own album to store photos. It was difficult, but the job got done.

Also, work on the environment is currently underway; the game is still scheduled for release in the spring of 2024.
